content.text: {"findings":[],"floor_verdicts":[],"watching":[{"thing":"laya: a decision engine that makes typed choice, score and yes/no decisions over text in one pass","why":"It does a job close to rule-based model routing, but it is Python-only, so the Node app can't load it today.","source":"https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya"}],"held_back":[{"thing":"omniroute (unified AI router with 375 providers)","date":"2026-10-19","reason":"A separate routing gateway would add a hop; the product already routes by user-defined rules with a required fallback and cooldown.","source":"https://www.npmjs.com/package/omniroute"},{"thing":"@ruvector/typesafe (local typed decisions over sentence embeddings)","date":"2026-09-29","reason":"The product's router rules are user-defined and its labels are not fixed ahead of time, and the package's record doesn't state a gain for this code.","source":"https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ruvector/typesafe"}]}
